name: MLflowとOpenTelemetryの違いとは？AI Agent Observabilityでの役割分担を整理
summary: Qiita article on how MLflow and OpenTelemetry divide their roles in AI agent observability.
description: Japanese-language article by @mellowlaunch (posted 14 September 2026) explaining the difference between MLflow and OpenTelemetry for AI agent observability: OpenTelemetry handles telemetry across the whole system, MLflow covers AI-agent-specific execution and quality, and the two are combined in practice. Adapted from the book ゼロから触ってわかった！AI Agent Observability入門.
contains: role split between MLflow and OpenTelemetry
MLflow handles AI agent execution and quality
based on the book ゼロから触ってわかった！AI Agent Observability入門
